name: Gamma Jump
description: Turns the Jellyfin Web alphabet picker into direct A–Z jumping across supported complete library grids without filtering the rendered result.
overview: Plex-style alphabet jumping for supported Jellyfin Web libraries while keeping the complete rendered result visible.
